prompt: What are the lyrics to the popular, unofficial fight song of the university that the main character of Gilmore Girls attended?
answer:
The song is **“Bulldog,” Yale University’s unofficial fight song**, written by Cole Porter. Its best-known refrain begins:

> “Bulldog, bulldog, bow, wow, wow—  
> Eli Yale!”

It celebrates Yale’s Bulldogs and urges them onward to victory.
